description: Offline structure-and-content analysis of a TLS 1.3 record stream whose 5-byte record headers are still present. Infers record boundaries, clusters, aligns, proposes field candidates, and attempts bounded content recovery on the record payloads without any decryption material.
limitations: Record boundaries are inferred from the repeated length field alone; the content-type and handshake-type bytes are read directly and checked against RFC 8446, not inferred.
A recovered record boundary is not plaintext: without decryption material the record payloads stay ciphertext.

Content recovery is limited to the regions RFC 8446 declares unprotected (record headers, the handshake messages before the protection boundary, and the change_cipher_spec dummy); protected bytes are refused and counted, never decoded.

Which regions count as unprotected is declared to M08 from RFC 8446, not inferred from the bytes: the declaration is an input to the analysis, and the recovered bytes are reported as declared regions rather than as a discovered layout.
